original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Re-derive from literal words and callers the complete-invoice surplus accounting of the P104 chain (native margin -(16p+O), caller margin p(17k-1), S = 48k - ports), the E8 structure of the 104 ports (O+(8,2) form, two removed orthoframes, stabiliser 384, wall and Gram comparison), the 8 x 7 decomposition of the 56 units of private-descent mass with its dim-7 certificate, and a mixed-port bound under the #968 cost law.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a source-bound construction. This package is a set of exact accounting identities and structure facts with literal replays on pending words; it constructs no new word and claims no kappa.
bottleneck_link: docs/research/research-family-status.md; the surplus S and the private-descent mass O are the two word-side terms of the complete signed invoice.
stop_rule: No kappa claim. The identities are stated with their hypotheses; any application still needs its own complete invoice and the five framework assumptions of the cited words.

open_questions.question: Does the outer margin law p(17k - 1) and the stage balance 2p per stage hold for the final #6716 caller and every later root?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Theorem 3.1 uses the law as an input; it is checked on three literal callers only.
open_questions.first_step: Run the caller accounting of verify.py on each further caller word and compare the outer margin with 104(17k - 1).
open_questions.blocked_by: Literal caller words of the other frontier steps as committed inputs.

open_questions.question: Can a legal word realise exactly the Gram operator (no defect rows) at private-descent mass 56?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 40 differing entries of O against the E8 Gram are the only departure from the rank-8 model of Theorem 7.3.
open_questions.first_step: Remove the two defect rows by rewriting the public network of the rows of ports 69 and 276 and replay the endpoint.
open_questions.blocked_by: A legal rewrite of the public relay core and its complete invoice.

open_questions.question: Is the hypothesis of disjoint single-stage chains removable from the 56-unit lower bound?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Chains read or written at several frames, and forks, are outside Theorem 7.3.
open_questions.first_step: Extend the frame-containment argument to terms with supports split across frames and recompute the mass bound.
open_questions.blocked_by: A frame-by-frame accounting of multi-stage hops; no new data expected.
